biography.plain_text: Princess Caroline of Monaco, Princess of Hanover, is the eldest child of Prince Rainier III and Princess Grace. long_biography.plain_text:
Princess Caroline fulfilled her mother's wish to revive ballet in Monaco by establishing a permanent company in 1985. She entrusted its artistic direction to Ghislaine Thesmar and Pierre Lacotte, later appointing Jean-Christophe Maillot to lead it. Under her presidency, the company was united with Monaco's dance festival and ballet academy, bringing performance, training and the presentation of visiting artists into one organisation.

She also founded Jeune J'Ecoute, a telephone service for young people in Monaco. It enabled callers to discuss their difficulties with trained staff, whatever the problem troubling them.
long_biography.html:
Princess Caroline fulfilled her mother's wish to revive ballet in Monaco by establishing a permanent company in 1985. She entrusted its artistic direction to Ghislaine Thesmar and Pierre Lacotte, later appointing Jean-Christophe Maillot to lead it. Under her presidency, the company was united with Monaco's dance festival and ballet academy, bringing performance, training and the presentation of visiting artists into one organisation.

She also founded Jeune J'Ecoute, a telephone service for young people in Monaco. It enabled callers to discuss their difficulties with trained staff, whatever the problem troubling them.
